title: Login and read projection

commands.report: 262 unit tests pass; runtime-login.test.mjs covers W05/W17/W18/W28

tests: W05 surfaceVersion carries bootId+sequence and invalidate advances it
W05 wait wakes on a later invalidation without a lost wakeup
W05 wait returns immediately when the boot id differs
W05 a health change bumps the surface version without touching the store
W18 a successful login commits credentials and enables control in one transaction
W18 one session per account: a new scan cancels the old and its late result is ignored
W18 a loginId from a previous boot reports EXPIRED
W17 a late result never overwrites a newer account edit
a channel without login capability is UNSUPPORTED
